rightCream: THE REAL PRODUCT · A DEMO SALON

beats.cap: Every business has them: *customers* who simply stopped coming.
beats.sayPro: [serious] Every business has them: customers who simply stopped coming.

beats.cap: Nobody calls them. Nobody even knows *who* they are.
beats.sayPro: [tired] Nobody calls them. Nobody even knows who they are.

beats.cap: And an offer blasted to everyone is spam. It gets *ignored.*
beats.sayPro: [frustrated] And an offer blasted to everyone is spam. It gets ignored.

beats.cap: This is Nayaversse *Growth.* It brings them back, and shows whether it worked.
beats.say: This is Nayaversse Growth. It brings them back, and shows whether it worked.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] This is नयावर्स Growth. It brings them back, and shows whether it worked.

beats.cap: It starts with *consent.* Nobody is messaged until they have agreed, and that is on record.
beats.sayPro: [confident] It starts with consent. Nobody is messaged until they have agreed, and that is on record.

beats.cap: A QR code at the counter lets a customer *agree* by themselves.
beats.sayPro: A Q R code at the counter lets a customer agree by themselves.

beats.cap: Say how long they have been away. It finds the *thirty* people, and tells you who it left out, and why.
beats.sayPro: Say how long they have been away. It finds the thirty people, and tells you who it left out, and why.

beats.cap: You type the offer. And only the owner can *approve* it.
beats.sayPro: You type the offer. And only the owner can approve it.

beats.cap: Then the proof. Thirteen people booked again after the message, worth ten thousand three hundred *rupees.*
beats.sayPro: [pleased] Then the proof. Thirteen people booked again after the message, worth ten thousand three hundred rupees.

beats.cap: And a few people are held back and *not* messaged, so you see who would have come anyway.
beats.sayPro: And a few people are held back and not messaged, so you see who would have come anyway.

beats.cap: Every message shows whether it was read, and who *booked* again.
beats.sayPro: Every message shows whether it was read, and who booked again.

beats.cap: And every Monday, the week arrives on the owner's own *WhatsApp.*
beats.sayPro: And every Monday, the week arrives on the owner's own WhatsApp.

beats.say: Nayaversse Growth. Built, and looking for its first business. Ask about a pilot at nayaversse dot in.
beats.sayPro: [warmly] नयावर्स Growth. Built, and looking for its first business. [friendly] Ask about a pilot at नयावर्स dot in.
